name: Deshi Shahi Cow
description: Healthy deshi cow suitable for Qurbani. Well fed with natural food, green grass and organic grains on a Bogura pasture. Gentle temperament, clear eyes, and fully compliant with the physical conditions required for sacrifice.

name: Red Chittong Cow
description: Indigenous Red Chittagong cattle raised under veterinary supervision in the Chattogram hills. Famous for dense muscle, rich red coat and excellent meat quality. Teeth condition verified for the third year, ideal for a family Qurbani.

name: Black Bengal Goat
description: Purebred Black Bengal buck prized for the sweetest, most tender meat in the region. Glossy black coat, well developed horns, past 14 months of age and reared on green legumes and natural forage.

name: Sahiwal Prime Cow
description: Magnificent reddish brown Sahiwal bull with a prominent hump and strong bone structure. Farm reared on silage, mineral licks and clean water. High meat yield, calm handling, and a documented health certificate.

name: Jamunapari Royal Goat
description: Tall and majestic Jamunapari buck with a convex facial profile and long pendulous ears. Impeccably groomed, strong legs, and fed on clover hay and seasonal greens. A distinguished choice for Eid-ul-Adha.

name: Brahman Master Bull
description: Colossal Brahman bull with a silvery grey coat and powerful frame. Raised at a registered Savar cattle farm with expert veterinary care. Ideal for a shared family sacrifice of seven shares thanks to its exceptional weight.

name: Sindhi Pabna Cross Cow
description: Well balanced Sindhi and Pabna cross bull raised on the banks of the Ichamati river. Naturally fattened without hormones, symmetrical horns, bright eyes, and a very steady temperament for an easy Qurbani.

name: Boer Cross Goat
description: Heavy Boer cross buck with the characteristic white body and brown head. Fast growing bloodline, thick muscling and a friendly nature. Fed on a balanced ration of hay, maize and fresh fodder every day.
